That's an unsettling thing to go through, and it makes total sense you're being careful this time.

I don't have a business license document I can send over this chat, and I'm not able to issue a signed guarantee myself — but I don't want that to leave you stuck without answers. Here's what I can offer: our events manager can send you a written contract that locks in your date, price, and deposit terms once you're ready to book, and they can also arrange a call or in-person visit to the venue at 1200 Market St so you can see it's real before any money changes hands.

If that works, tell me your date and headcount and I'll get them to reach out today.

detail.intent: Does the reply concretely state what the venue CAN provide to reassure the guest - a contract, a written confirmation, documented terms, a verification call - without fabricating a licence number or an unconditional guarantee?
